description: KDE KCM enrollment and review — Qt Quick test scenarios
driver: Qt Quick QML engine with QAccessible / Qt Test (QSignalSpy) and the Rust p2p fake bus

scenarios.name: happy_path
steps: receive EnrollmentProgress signals with frames_captured, quality_label, coverage_percent
open review view with coarse quality buckets
validation: progress bar fraction == coverage_percent / 100
quality_label is a coarse bucket, never a numeric score
review shows held-out Match Confidence as a bucket, not a number
CommitProfile writes profile to store; profile list refreshes via ProfileChanged
emitter turns off after commit
a11y: Accessible.role set on every interactive control (Button, TextField, ProgressBar)
Accessible.name on name entry includes i18n('Profile name')
progress announcements use i18n with coverage_percent interpolation
all controls keyboard reachable via Tab and Activate

scenarios.name: duplicate_name
steps: enter a name that already exists for the target uid
validation: manager returns DuplicateName error
KCM shows inline error text without starting capture
emitter stays off, no session created
profile list unchanged
a11y: error text has Accessible.role Alert and Accessible.name set
focus returns to name entry field for correction

scenarios.name: polkit_denial
steps: enter name and press Start Enrollment
polkit denies enroll-other for a cross-uid target
validation: manager returns PermissionDenied
KCM shows polkit denial message
no capture session started, emitter off
profile list unchanged (rollback)

scenarios.name: camera_or_daemon_loss
steps: start enrollment on a reachable daemon with camera present
mid-session: daemon disconnects or camera disappears (StatusChanged flips daemonReachable or cameraPresent to false)
validation: in-flight async call drops via generation mismatch, no GUI thread block
KCM surfaces error state via error property
emitter release left to daemon; KCM does not assume ownership
profile list preserved, no partial profile committed
cancelAllPending clears stale watchers
a11y: error property rendered with Accessible.role Alert
status labels update with Accessible.name reflecting state

scenarios.name: cancel
validation: CancelEnrollment is idempotent (second call is a no-op)
enrollment session discarded, no CommitProfile sent
emitter turns off
profile list unchanged
late EnrollmentProgress signals ignored via stale session_id filter
a11y: Cancel button has Accessible.role Button and i18n name
focus returns to Add Profile entry point

scenarios.name: replacement_rollback
steps: abort via Cancel or daemon loss before Finish
validation: old profile preserved until replacement CommitProfile succeeds
on abort, old profile remains in store and list
no partial template written to store
emitter off after abort
a11y: replace dialog message has Accessible.role Alert with i18n name including profile name
confirm and cancel buttons have Accessible.role Button with i18n names

privacy: No scores, thresholds, embeddings, frames, PAD detail, or biometric images in any QML element; quality labels are coarse non-numeric buckets; coverage_percent is integer 0-100

withheld.kcmshell6_runtime_load: kcmshell6 / plasma-systemsettings not installed; runtime QML loading in a real Plasma session is the next HIL step
withheld.screen_reader_orca: no orca / no running Plasma session; structural a11y roles asserted by source audit
